home.features.quench.description.message: Incremental build cache that tracks file hashes and only rebuilds what actually changed. Cold forges take 14 seconds. Warm forges take under two.

home.features.bellows.title.description: Front page Features card title for Bellows

home.features.bellows.description.message: Parallel task runner that fans work across every workspace package simultaneously. Respects the dependency graph from Tongs so nothing runs before its prerequisites finish.

home.features.crucible.title.description: Front page Features card title for Crucible

showcase.blogPreviewWithDesc.post2.descr.message: How Quench caching and Bellows parallelism turned a twelve-minute build into a fourteen-second forge.

showcase.blogPreviewWithDesc.post3.title.message: The Warden Rules We Almost Did Not Ship

showcase.blogPreviewWithDesc.post3.descr.message: We wrote 380 linting rules and threw away 60. Here is what survived and the arguments that almost split the team.
